title: Your feed stays live, even when social platforms go down
content: Smash Balloon's backup caching system stores a copy of your feed data locally inside WordPress. So if your connected platform has an outage, your feed keeps displaying instead of going blank.

title: Add your feed to any page with a shortcode or block
content: You can embed your Smash Balloon feed anywhere on your site using a Gutenberg block or shortcode — pages, posts, sidebars, footers. Add it once and it auto-updates every time you post on social.
